description: This Java source file defines an enum called 'RatingScale' representing various rating levels for books within a book tracking application. It includes constants for ratings from 'No rating' to '10/10', methods to convert ratings to and from double values, and annotations for JSON serialization and code analysis.

classes.name: RatingScale
classes.description: Enumeration of star ratings for books, supporting conversion between string labels and numeric values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of the rating for display purposes.

methods.name: toDouble
methods.description: Converts a RatingScale enum constant to its corresponding Double value wrapped in Optional.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Finds the RatingScale enum constant matching a given Double rating value, or the NO_RATING if null.
